name.en: Teleport Homer (Once per battle, per unit)

text.en: At the start of the battle, you can set up one Teleport Homer token for this unit on the battlefield. If you do: When you target this unit with the Rapid Ingress stratagem, you can use that Teleport Homer token. If you do, that use is -1 CP, but when resolving that stratagem, this unit must be set up within 3" of that Teleport Homer token and not within 8" of an enemy unit. That Teleport Homer token is then removed from the battlefield. If an enemy unit ends a move within 1" of that Teleport Homer token, that Teleport Homer token is removed from the battlefield.
